title: C, XOXO
intro: TO SUPPORT THE  RELEASE OF CAMILLA CABELLO’S FOURTH STUDIO ALBUM, WE TOOK IT BACK TO HER MIAMI ROOTS WITH A TWO-PART ACTIVATION FOR SUPER FANS, PRESS AND INFLUENCERS ALIKE.

introPieces.html:
First, we produced a one-night only Miami yacht party to host a curated crowd. The  docked yacht overlooked the Miami skyline, providing the perfect backdrop for guests to hear Camilla’s new tracks.  

The very next day, we transformed a local 7-Eleven gas station, providing fans and the wider public an opportunity to shop inside a totally rebranded bodega.

pieces.left: Influencers, tastemakers, press and a select handful of lucky super fans were invited to attend an intimate evening on a decorated yacht, complete with specialty Bacardi cocktails, boozy popsicles and Cuban-inspired refreshments and Bacardi infused cocktails and popsicles, amplifying her partnership with the brand.
pieces.right: Camila arrived to the surprise and delight of all, hosting a first listen of the record alongside new visuals, adding her own intimate details and notes of inspiration. The preview ended with a  celebratory C,XOXO cake and a live DJ to round out the evening; all left with exclusive merch takeaway bags.

pieces.left: To serve a wider fanbase and the general public, we transformed a 7-Eleven into a shoppable bodega of all things C,XOXO. Leaning into the dusk blue that was the inspiration to her album art, we completely rebranded the space with her signature logo, moody lighting and bold graphics.
pieces.right: Exclusive merch, free slurpees, our self-designed zine and unique photo moments drew a line down the block that fans talked about all week long. Camila made a surprise appearance, waving to fans and capturing content inside of the store.

work.summary: To celebrate the release of Camila Cabello’s C,XOXO, we took over a 7-Eleven in Miami to sell merch and hosted superfans, influencers and notable press on a docked yacht to preview the new music.
